arStrings.szText:
You Summon a {c_important}Poison Frog{/c} to {if:SF_2}accompany you. Its tongue Pulls In enemies, Taunts them for {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} second, and deals {c_random}{SF_16}{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}{SF_8}{/c} seconds.{else}repeatedly attack enemies, dealing {c_random}{SF_16}{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}{SF_8}{/c} seconds.{/if}

When it dies, the frog explodes violently for {c_random}{SF_17}{/c} Poison damage that is guaranteed to Critically Strike.
Purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
{c_important}Poison Frog{/c} attacks now Pull In and Taunt enemies for {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} second.
